title: RandItem
description: RandItem, a mod that randomly spawns items if your in survival or creative
body:
Have you ever wanted items?

Are you too poor to afford items in Survival?

Are you too lazy to spawn items?

This is the mod!

This mod gives you **Rand**om **Item**s!

Thats the meaning of "**RandItem**"

It chooses ANY item from the Minecraft creative inventory and spawns it inside yours!

Try now! You will regret i- **NOT** regret it :)

Only supported for **1.16 - 1.16.x**

NOTE: it will spawn the items every 1 second so your inventory will get full!!!!!
